# Alex Example — public context

Version 2026.1 · Public draft · Owner review pending
Canonical: https://example.com/
License: CC BY 4.0, Alex Example.

## Who I am
I am Alex Example, a fictional person used to demonstrate the PPCP draft. I write about
public infrastructure and I maintain this profile myself. This section is my own
self-description, not an independently verified account.

## Family and personal life
I live in a small flat with my partner Sam and our elderly cat. Weekends are for slow
cooking, long walks and calling my mother. I mention this because a person is not a CV,
and because these commitments genuinely shape when and how I work.

## How I like to work
Written first, meetings second. I answer asynchronously within a day. If a decision needs
me, say so explicitly — I do not read urgency into silence.

## Sourced facts
I have spoken at the fictional Open Web Days conference, as listed in its public
programme. That claim is sourced, not self-asserted.
